learning_objective: 🎯 Take a deep breath and relax! Learn how ancient Yoga helps calm your mind, stretch your body, and bring pure joy to your day.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Yoga is a magical science from ancient India that connects our body, mind, and breath. It helps us stay calm when we are stressed and makes our bodies super strong and flexible.
Breathing slowly and deeply sends a message to your brain to relax. It helps clear your mind before a big test or when you are trying to learn something new!
Yoga Asanas (poses) are often inspired by nature! When you stand tall like a tree or stretch like a cat, you are building balance and wonderful posture.

fun_activity.title: 🌳 Be a Strong Tree
fun_activity.instructions: Stand on one leg, place your other foot on your ankle or calf, bring your hands together at your chest, and hold your balance for 15 seconds. Don't forget to smile and breathe!

quick_recap: ⭐ Yoga connects the mind and body for complete holistic health and peace.
⭐ Deep breathing (Pranayama) helps us focus better and feel relaxed instantly.
⭐ Practicing Asanas improves our balance, flexibility, and overall body posture.
